ImageDescription.value:
Turkey Breast in Tomato & Paprika www.rexipe.com/recipes/607-turkey_breast_in_tomato__paprika

Summary This is a great healthy dish ... I like it in the summer with some wholemeal pitta bread, salad and yogurt

Ingredients 4 Turkey Breast 4 Tablespoons of Olive Oil 2 crushed garlic cloves 1 small chilli (chopped) 1 small punnet of cherry tomatoes 1/2 bunch of fresh coriander (chopped) 4 Tablespoons of tomato puree 1 teaspoon of paprika

Method Mix the olive oil, garlic and chilli to create a marinate

Coat the Turkey breasts and leave overnight

Take a dish and place the turkey breasts in the dish

Mix the coriander, tomato puree and paprika, add some of the marinade to this mixture and stir well

Coat the turkey breasts with the sauce above

Place the cherry tomatoes around the turkey breasts

Cook in the oven on 200C for around 30 minutes

Cool and serve with wholemeal pitta bread, salad and yogurt

To see more recipes like this please visit us as www.rexipe.com

Thanks [1] Faz

Ingredients (for two people): - 200g of pork (a block of Boston butt) - 1/2 onion - 1/2 celery - a carrot - a bell pepper - a piece of garlic - a can of cooked tomato - two laurel leaves - 10 grains of black pepper - 100ml of red wine - olive oil - salt - a bouillon cube

Directions: 1. Chop the onion, garlic, bell pepper, carrot, and celery. 2. Cut the pork into 3-cm sized cubic pieces. Prick each piece several times with a knife to soften. 3. Saute the chopped garlic and onion with olive oil in a pan until onion becomes translucent. 4. Grill the pieces of pork with olive oil in a fry pan until their surface color changes. 5. Put the grilled pork, chopped celery, carrot, bell pepper, laurel leaves, and black pepper into the pan. Mix and stir-fry them all. 6. Put the red wine, cooked tomato, and bouillon cube into the pan. Pour in just enough water to cover them. Add salt to taste.

7. Cover the pan with a lid and cook over low flame for one hour. Keep an eye to prevent scorching.

ImageDescription.value:
Simple vegetable soup
  • 64 oz. free range chicken broth
  • 15 oz. can tomato sauce
  • 15 oz. can Italian diced tomatoes
  • 2 small bags of baby carrots, chopped (2 lbs.)
  • 1 whole bundle of celery (chopped large, including leaves)
  • 15 oz. frozen package of peas or other vegetable
  • 1 large onion
  • 2 bay leaves, clove of garlic, salt, pepper and other spices
  • 2 tablespoons white vinegar
  • 9 red potatoes or so (cut very small and added right when heat is turned off, or add a little sooner)
  • salt and pepper

Put everything in an 8-quart pot and simmer for an hour or so with lid on. Add small-cut potatoes right at the end. Add plenty of salt if needed.

Optional:

  • lots of other vegetables or meat can be added
  • boil some spinach or chard or artichokes and add the leftover water
  • add some cabbage
  • add fresh parsley *with root* (get at Whole Foods)
  • use 1 lb. dry, whole grain rice instead of potatoes

ImageDescription.value:
These were very well received. I was pretty pleased with them myself. The wine sauce was excellent and the mascarpone filling was excellent. I kept telling people it was a Mark Bittman recipe, but it is in fact a Michael Chiarello recipe. I never watched his show for more than a few minutes but I think he did a lot of stuff that would be right at home in a Bittman cookbook: simple but no shortcuts. Whether or not that's actually true, this was a very simple <a href="http://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/michael-chiarello/red-wine-poached-pears-with-mascarpone-filling-recipe/index.html">recipe</a>.

I used vanilla extract instead of a vanilla bean. I used three different sugars but only because I had small amounts laying around. I think those were my only deviations from the recipe.

ObjectName.value: Stir-fry spinach with tofu - Golden white jade and Green Parrot (菠菜炒豆腐 - 金鑲白玉板，紅嘴綠鸚哥)(2)

Categories.value: Tofu dishes of China|Vegetable-based food of China|Deep-fried tofu|Self-published work|Spinach-based food|Chinese cuisine in the United States|Stir fried vegetables of China|Food in Clovis, California|Food in the United States photographed in 2019

ImageDescription.value:
A dish of Stir-Fry Spinach with Tofu 菠菜炒豆腐, also referred as 金鑲白玉板，紅嘴綠鸚哥[1], roughly translated in English as Golden White Jade and Green Parrot. In China, it is rumored that both Qianlong Emperor and Empress Dowager Cixi liked the simple-yet-delicious stir-fried dish. Picture taken in Clovis California.

Recipe:

  • a pack of firm tofu
  • 4 cups of cooking oil for deep-frying (or 2 teaspoons of it for air frying)
  • 2/3 pound of spinach
  • 1/4 pound ground pork
  • 1/2 tablespoon minced garlic
  • 1/3 teaspoon salt
  • 1/3 teaspoon pepper
  • 1/3 sesame oil

1. Cut tofu into pieces, pat dry with a paper towel 2. Heat oil and deep-fry tofu for 4 minutes over high heat until crispy and golden. Remove and drain. (Alternatively, if rather using an air fryer instead, cook on 370ºF for 20 minutes after coating the tofu with just 2 teaspoons of cooking oil.)

3. Rinse spinach then cut into 4 section. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoon oil and then stir-fry minced garlic and ground pork until fragrant. Add the spinach and stir-fry briefly. Add 1/3 cup of water and add salt, pepper, and sesame oil with fried tofu and cook until steamy; continue to cook for 2 minutes. Remove and serve.

  2. приготувати тісто для вареників — вода ~90ºC, сіль, борошно — залишити його «відпочивати»;

  4. викласти зліплені вареники на дошку (стільницю) присипану борошном;
  5. довести до кипіння воду, опустити партію вареників, перемішати, довести до кипіння знову;
  6. заправити готові вареники маслом, потрусити миску з варениками, щоб не злиплися, додати сметану

Tuna Pasta Salad

Categories.value: Pasta salad|Flickr images reviewed by File Upload Bot (Magnus Manske)|Salads with tuna|Sliced eggs|Penne rigate dishes

ImageDescription.value:
Pasta, tuna, artichoke, sundried tomato, egg, spring onion. Dressing of mayo, shallot, limejuice, thym, pepper, salt.

I prepare everything first (dressing, draining, chopping, etc) and then in the end I put everything together.

For pasta for two just mix together:

  • 150-200g penne, drained, quickly rinsed with cold water, so it's still warm, but cold is okay too.
  • 1 can of artichoke hearts, cut into small 1 x 2 cm pieces.
  • dressing of

3 T mayo 2 t limejuice 1 shallot, chopped finely 1 T fresh thym (although I think just using fresh basil would have been nicer) salt/pepper

Mix that thoroughly, then carefully mix/fould with: 1 pot of nice tuna in oil, broken into pieces 5 pieces of sundried tomatoes in oil, chopped in 1 x 0.5 cm pieces 2 spring onions, sliced thinly

Divide over 2 bowls, put the soft boiled egg on top. (one per person)

And like I said, I think I would have preferred a big handfull of fresh basil of maybe flatleave parsley.
